response.overview: After a long relationship, Zariman finally proposes to Arissa to be his wife and begins wedding planning. Arissa is torn in a dilemma, afraid that after she marries and moves away, Suraya will not be able to take care of their grandmother (Saleha) properly. Meanwhile, Rafael is caught in a marital crisis when he suspects Diana is cheating on him. Diana finally confesses that she cheated and asks Rafael to let her go. Arissa and Zariman's wedding is destroyed when Rafael hits Zariman while Rafael is chasing his wife Diana who is trying to escape with their daughter Mimi. Zariman dies in the accident, and Arissa suffers severe depression. Zaki takes care of Arissa and the welfare of Arissa's family, secretly still harboring feelings for Arissa. Arissa accepts Zaki's proposal, although she is still anxious and knows her heart still belongs to Zariman. Rafael, who wants to come clean, accidentally falls in love with Arissa. The drama cast of Arissa's Vengeful Love.
response.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
